verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's core functionality (scraping, JS rendering, screenshots, extraction, proxies, search, AI queries, usage stats) is exposed via a rich, well-documented API and even a CLI wrapper, suggesting near-total feature parity with any UI. However, no evidence covers account/billing management or other dashboard-only settings that might not have API equivalents. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that account/billing/dashboard-only features are also API-accessible, and an official OpenAPI spec (probe shows 404s) that would formalize full API surface parity.
